note: Only a capability with a `replay` object is replicated by a running node (RD_12.6 plan §0.1, D12). default_prob applies to a replayable capability that gives no replicate_prob of its own; a capability without `replay` is never replicated live, whatever its probability. replicate_prob without `replay` is still read by the conformance layer.

demo.command-issue.note: high consequence: a tier-4 command-class task. The doc's 'scale replication to consequence' is realized here by the OPERATOR setting a large probability, in proportion to the capability weight it already authors in trust_ladder.json -- not by deriving one opaquely. p*L>g makes cheating unprofitable, and L is a tier demotion, so even this need not be 1.0

demo.thermal-forecast.note: a routine predictive capability the certificate and calibration layers already constrain; replication is the last recourse (build-order step 6), so its share is small

demo.query.note: a read-only query verifiable by other means; never worth a second executor. 0.0 is a real setting, not the absence of one

demo.integrate.note: a step-structured computation its executor commits to as a hash-chained trace of at most max_steps states (each at most max_state_bytes). No replicate_prob, so default_prob applies; a disagreement goes to the bisection game, settled by re-executing one step
